newsitem.title: UK: Morgan Stanley books million bbls Brent to US Gulf.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley books million bbls Brent to US Gulf.

text.p: U.S. bank Morgan Stanley hired a tanker to carry a million barrels of Brent crude to the U.S. Gulf, shipping brokers said.
Morgan Stanley chartered the London Splendour to sail on October 10 from British North Sea terminal Sullom Voe, the brokers said.
It was not immediately clear whether the cargo was fixed firm or on subjects.
Transatlantic Brent shipments have been scarce over the past week or so because of difficult arbitrage economics.
